comments.body: The other day I was in Cape Town and I saw this fellow with a big mustache. I asked him how he obtained it and he said it was through this tool, but I tried it and it's not the case. It allows you to choose from the default options given when you first create your character. Is there anyone who can tell me how to obtain that mustache? I want it! o.o

comments.author: Guilder
comments.body:
Correction to my previous statement: transformation tools allow you change your character's facial appearance. Apart from the beginner defaults (eyepatch, scar, so on), there are also extra options. For both genders, a monocle. And for men, a needle-thin mustache. The one you've described seems to come from this item:

Aphrodite's Mirror

I haven't used it personally, but this website has a screenshot with the mustache you've described.

Screenshot: www.gamecity.ne.jp/dol/service/serial_number.htm

comments.author: Guilder
comments.body: One thought: I haven't tested the transformation tools on a player model like the one shown in the screenshot. It's possible the mustache (option #11 for both the mirror and the tools) changes style based on your character's model. Can someone confirm/deny this?
